what_happened: test-lean-challenge-snapshot.sh has no fixture/case exercising the present-but-empty '## Lean Challenge Statements' section (zero ```lean fenced blocks -> extract_r1 status 2 -> exit 71). Acceptance criterion (c) requires this path stay a hard loud failure after the zero-goal marker is added; the implementation phase must add this missing regression fixture/case, not merely assume existing coverage.

The research report arrived implementation-ready: nine numbered decisions, exact insertion points for both markdown edits, and an itemised shape for the three script edit sites. Planning needed only to verify the named line ranges still match the source store and to assign verification tiers -- no design question had to be re-litigated and no re-research round was needed.

suite-selection-lib.sh maps touched paths against exactly one scripts tree (core's, or the merged deployed tree), and explicitly scopes out a source-store path belonging to a non-core extension while still un-deployed. Both script-touching phases of this plan edit agent-system/extensions/lean/scripts/**, so suite_selection_select would escalate them to __FULL_SWEEP__ rather than naming the obvious paired suite test-lean-challenge-snapshot.sh. Worked around by naming that suite's direct invocation as the covering check in each Tier Justification instead of a run-all.sh --only selection.

Phase 4 added three new test fixtures but Phase 4's own task list did not call out registering them in agent-system/extensions/lean/manifest.json's provides.scripts array; the first Phase 5 deploy silently skipped deploying them as a result. Discovered via check-extension-docs.sh's post-deploy completeness check, fixed by adding the three entries and redeploying a second time.

The two deliberate mutation checks specified in Phase 4's verification criteria (removing the marker substring test from extract_r1; removing the zero-goal arm of the GOALS_FILE branch) both correctly turned Z1/Z4 RED while leaving R21 and Z3 green, confirming the new regression cases are not vacuous before committing.
